title: The Sweet History of Luqaimat: A Qatari Tradition
desc: What are Luqaimat? Explore their place in Qatari food culture, names and syrup variations, with links to CATHAREi’s current sweets menu.
body:
Luqaimat, meaning "bite-sized" in Arabic, is arguably the most famous and beloved traditional dessert in Qatar and the Gulf region, especially during the holy month of Ramadan.

These crispy, golden dough balls are famously crunchy on the outside, incredibly airy on the inside, and completely drenched in rich date syrup (dibs) or honey. But where did this sweet tradition originate?

Luqaimat in Qatari food culture

Qatar Tourism includes Luqaimat among the country’s traditional dishes and describes it as a popular Ramadan sweet. This establishes its place in Qatar’s food culture; it does not establish one country or date as its sole origin. Read Visit Qatar’s guide to local street food for that cultural context.

Names, texture and toppings

You may see the spellings Luqaimat, Luqimat or Lokma. These small fried sweets are known for the contrast between their outer crust and soft centre. Syrups and toppings vary between recipes, so check the product description when choosing a portion rather than assuming every version uses the same ingredients.

Choosing Luqaimat from the current menu

At CATHAREi, fresh Luqaimat is available year-round at our Salwa Road, Al Wakrah and Al Kharaitiyat branches. Explore our current Arabic sweets menu for products and prices, or contact a branch about your order.

For a gathering, ask your preferred branch about portions, preparation time and allergens. If you are comparing sweets for an event, explore our catering and occasions information.

title: The Ultimate Guide to Arabic Sweets for Corporate Gifting
desc: Plan Arabic sweet gifts for clients and colleagues in Qatar: compare portions and confirm packaging, allergens and timing with CATHAREi.
body:
When it comes to corporate gifting in Doha, nothing conveys respect, hospitality, and appreciation quite like a luxury box of premium Arabic sweets.

Whether you are thanking a loyal client, celebrating a company milestone, or sending Eid greetings, traditional desserts like Pistachio Baklava and Maamoul are universally loved.

At CATHAREi Bakery, our beautifully curated sweet boxes are designed to leave a lasting impression. With rich flavors, intricate craftsmanship, and elegant packaging, they represent the pinnacle of Middle Eastern culinary heritage.

Planning a corporate sweets order

Start with the number of recipients, your preferred collection or delivery date, and the budget for each gift. Decide whether you need individual gifts or sweets to share at an event. Compare the products and listed portions on our Arabic sweets menu, then ask the branch to confirm suitable quantities.

Details to confirm before ordering

Ask about available packaging, ingredients and allergens, preparation time, and arrangements for the intended destination. Do not assume a particular presentation or delivery time is included without confirming it. Our corporate gifting page explains the existing service; for a larger gathering, see catering and occasions or contact a CATHAREi branch.
